Company description: TSM (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited, commonly known as TSM, is the world's largest dedicated independent semiconductor foundry. Founded in 1987 by Morris Chang, the company pioneered the pure-play foundry business model, meaning it manufactures integrated circuits based on proprietary designs submitted by its customers, rather than designing its own branded chips. TSM serves a global client base that includes leading fabless technology companies, producing advanced microchips that power smartphones, high-performance computing systems, automotive electronics, and artificial intelligence applications. Headquartered in Hsinchu Science Park, Taiwan, the company maintains a dominant market share in advanced fabrication nodes and operates an extensive network of manufacturing facilities globally to support the semiconductor supply chain.
